page: Microsoft Azure DC16as_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the DCasv6 server family. It is powered by an AMD processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features 16 dedicated virtual CPUs and 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning it relies entirely on external storage options, though it is designated as Premium Storage capable. There are no integrated graphics processing units or complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this instance.

Given the balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the DC16as_v6 is designed for general-purpose workloads. It is suitable for applications such as mid-sized web servers, enterprise application hosting, and development or testing environments. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities for workloads that require stable compute performance without resource sharing.
